label: Diagram 8.1
caption: Diagram 8.1 | Compartment floors: illustration of guidance in paragraph 8.11
description:
Diagram 8.1, titled "Compartment floors: illustration of guidance in paragraph 8.11", comprises four section and elevation views. A legend at top left reads "See para 8.11" and shows a green line symbolled "Compartment floor(s) or wall(s)".

a. A section on a grey ground line shows a left column of four stacked boxes: two upper boxes reading "Storey not exceeding 2000m²" and two lower green-shaded boxes reading "Storey exceeding 2000m² divided by compartment wall". To the right of the lower two boxes are two green-shaded boxes each reading "Compartment wall", with a "Roof" label above the top right box. A left dimension reads "30m max." Heading: "a. Example of compartmentation in an unsprinklered assembly and recreation, shop, or commercial building see paragraph 8.11a".

b. A tall elevation with horizontal green lines, dimensioned "> 30m" on the right. Heading: "b. Compartmentation in buildings over 30m see paragraph 8.11b".

c. A basement section with two storeys below grey ground, dimensioned "10m max." Heading: "c. Shallow basement see paragraph 8.11c".

d. A basement section with three storeys, dimensioned "> 10m". Heading: "d. Deep basement see paragraph 8.11d".
